scripts.db:migrate: docker-compose exec -T postgres psql -U bankpilot -d bankpilot < db/migrations/001_init.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec -T postgres psql -U bankpilot -d bankpilot < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:verify: docker-compose exec -T postgres psql -U bankpilot -d bankpilot < db/invariants.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
